title: Link a Document to a Contact
description: Attach an uploaded document to the correct contact record so evidence and workflow context are searchable and complete.
prerequisites: You have access to both the Files module and Contacts records.
The document has already been uploaded or is available to upload.
You know which contact record should own the document link.
steps: Open the Files module from the main navigation.
Locate the document to be linked, or upload it if it is not yet in the system.
Open document details and choose Link, Attach, or Assign to record.
Search for the target contact by name, email, or contact ID.
Select the correct contact record and confirm the link action.
Add document tags, notes, or category fields if your workflow requires them.
Save the document metadata and return to the contact profile.
Open the contact record and verify the linked document appears in attachments or evidence history.
validations: The document appears under the expected contact record attachments.
Document metadata reflects the correct contact linkage.
Searching by the contact shows the document in results.
commonErrors: Wrong contact selected during link operation.
Document linked but not visible on contact profile.
Permission rules block linking or viewing linked files.
recovery: Unlink and relink the document to the correct contact record.
Refresh the contact page and confirm filters are not hiding attachments.
Check file/contact permissions and request access update if required.

faq.question: Can one document be linked to multiple contacts?
faq.answer: Only if your workflow allows shared evidence; otherwise keep one primary owner to avoid ambiguity.

faq.question: How do I audit document linkage changes?
faq.answer: Use document history and contact activity logs to confirm who linked or relinked files and when.
